title: Don’t Talk to Strangers
description:
The sun's down, the school is dead silent, and everyone's long gone. All you have to do is grab the groceries and make it home. Simple, right? Too bad the streets outside aren't quite as empty as they look.

Don't Talk To Strangers is a psychological horror game about the terrifying vulnerability of being small in a world full of hidden threats. a dynamic sanity system, every choice and every conversation could be your last.

• Mind Your Sanity: The shadows are empty until your mind starts to slip, and the relentless stalker monster only hunts you when your sanity runs low. Cling to comfort where you can find it: swinging on a playground, picking kind responses, or just soaking in the buzzing, warm glow of a vending machine when you're too broke to buy anything. Nowhere is truly safe.

• Strangers: some are mundane, some stalkers and some I'll leave to you to discover. interact with the wrong one, and well you know there are 6 endings already. 

• Lethal Neighborhood Hazards: strangers aren't the only ones capable of harming or helping, you know. sometimes, our environment can be just as consequential.

• The School Ghost: Before you even hit the streets, you have to escape the building. Avoid the gaze of a dangerous little girl ghost too ashamed to show her face, and survive a heart pounding classroom chase.

• Key Features: you play as a child, after all. it is easy to get distressed and lose your cool, maybe even your mind... be careful out there.

• Town: explore the small town in the time beyond twilight, beware of danger and be curious for collectibles, they may just tell a different story...
description_short: "Mom said to come straight home... on time." You overslept, and the school is dark. Manage your crumbling sanity, evade strangers, and survive the lethal hazards of a quiet neighborhood. who knows, talking to the wrong stranger might be your very last mistake.
